steps.en: Install the DMG or the cask and open it
steps.zh: 装 DMG 或 cask，然后打开它

steps.en: On first launch downloads its own Homebrew into Application Support and runs it in API mode
steps.zh: 首启把自带 Homebrew 装进应用支持目录，以 API 模式运行

steps.en: Browse the handpicked gallery or search the whole cask catalogue
steps.zh: 逛精选画廊或搜索全部 cask 目录

steps.en: Installs the cask through that brew copy and reports progress in place
steps.zh: 用它那份 brew 安装该 cask 并就地显示进度

steps.en: Export a Brewfile so the same apps come back on the next Mac
steps.zh: 导出 Brewfile，换机时把同一批应用装回来

value.en: An App Store experience on a Mac that has never had Terminal or the Xcode Command Line Tools installed
value.zh: 在一台从没装过终端或 Xcode 命令行工具的 Mac 上，也能像逛商店一样装应用

sources: README.md What Sets Applite Apart (brings its own Homebrew, downloads a tarball into Application Support, API mode behind a git shim, uses an existing prefix if present)
README.md Key Features (one-click install/update/uninstall, self-contained Homebrew, handpicked gallery plus FTS5 search, Brewfile import and export, custom-tap casks)
README.md Built With (SQLite via GRDB; two-stage load: SQLite then brew list --cask / brew outdated --cask)
README.md Development and AI (sole maintainer; AI assistance disclosed from v1.4)
CLAUDE.md (HomebrewBootstrap; CaskDataLoader; custom taps via a brew ruby script)
